dialogue.speech: No one cares about your damn hunches!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I think we got a message from the boss!

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Message for Bucciarati

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This is how the boss always sends his orders to the capos.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This is the first time Bucciarati's received one!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll check out the message.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: "Head to the Pompeii Archaeological Park. I've hidden a key near the dog mosaic."

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Look into that immediately!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: "That key is for a vehicle that'll bring my daughter safely to me."

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Vehicle? What does he mean by a safe vehicle?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: A helicopter!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: That must be a key to a helicopter!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: We can go anywhere in a helicopter without anyone following us!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's a bit less than fifteen kilometers from here to Pompeii.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: An hour should be plenty of time to get over there and get the key.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Fugo! Abbacchio! Giorno!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You three head to Pompeii and get that key!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista, Narancia, and I will remain here and protect Trish from the Hitman Team.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Retrieve the key, and if it seems safe, contact us.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Then we'll take Trish and head to over to that vehicle.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm counting on you.
